title: Destructure Tuple Struct
goal: Extract tuple struct fields using pattern matching and proper dereferencing.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: User-Defined Types

hints: Tuple structs require their type name when pattern matching.
c is a reference, but you need copied u8 values for multiplication.
explanation: Destructuring a tuple struct requires the type name Color(r, g, b). Matching without the name causes type mismatch error E0308 because a tuple is not a struct. Dereferencing *c copies the three primitive u8 values out of the reference. Matching c directly without dereferencing binds r as a shared reference &u8, causing error E0369 when multiplying &u8 by u8.
